items.title: 🔴 LIVE: Reliance & Rolls-Royce Pitch AMCA Fighter Engine Deal | MeitY Rules Out Social Media Ban
items.summary:
Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce have announced their strategic intent to jointly develop a sovereign combat engine for India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, though a final government contract has not yet been awarded. In domestic policy, MeitY ruled out a blanket social media ban for children following stakeholder consultations, focusing instead on age-gating and safety frameworks. Meanwhile, India ranks 8th globally in AI models led by open-weight systems like Sarvam 105B, Elon Musk is pitching Starlink's Gen-2 satellites for rural connectivity, and space fellow Eshaan Bansal joins us to break down IN-SPACe’s proposed ₹500-crore space insurance scheme.

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.

- MeitY opts against a blanket social media ban for minors, exploring "safety by design" regulations instead
- India reaches 8th place globally in AI models with open-weight options like Sarvam 105B leading domestic adoption
- Elon Musk proposes Starlink Gen-2 network to connect 11,000 unserved rural Indian villages
- Spaceport SARABHAI Fellow Eshaan Bansal joins us live to unpack IN-SPACe’s ₹500-crore space insurance proposal
